class.name: SteamPartySlotsOperation
class.brief_description: Cancellable observer of an explicit change to available beacon slots.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns whether this observer reached a terminal result.

method.name: result
method.description: Returns the terminal result or null while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Returns the completed typed result, or the signal to await it.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Settles local observation with [constant ERR_SKIP]. Steam may still apply the submitted update.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once with this operation's terminal result.
